conventions.log_e: log10 exposure relative to an 18% gray card at normal exposure (camera stop 0): log_e = x - x_gray
conventions.sigma_d: diffuse rms granularity sigma_D at Kodak's 48 um aperture (multiply by 1000 for Kodak's rms value)
conventions.stop: one camera stop = log10(2) = 0.30103 in log_e

source.charts: 'Diffuse rms Granularity Curves' and 'Sensitometric Curves' (embedded rasters)
source.aperture_statement: Read with a microdensitometer, using a 48-micrometre aperture.
source.equipment_note: Note: This curve represents granularity based on modified measuring techniques. Sensitometric and Diffuse RMS Granularity curves are produced on different equipment. A slight variation in curve shape may be noticed.

kodak-vision3-250d-5207.x_gray_method: least-squares alignment of the granularity chart's three characteristic curves with the sensitometric chart's curves (stop axis at log10(2) per stop), free horizontal scale and free density offset, layers combined; see gray_placement.fits for every variant

mapping.primary_reason: Kodak's reading procedure is by density (density -> characteristic curve on the granularity chart -> sigma_D), and the sensitometric chart's camera-stop axis is the trustworthy exposure axis; the granularity chart's characteristic curves only match it with the stop spacing scaled by 0.86 (plus a density offset, which does not enter the x mapping)
mapping.alternative: unit scale: chart x = x_gray + log_e (granularity chart x taken as true log10 exposure)

engine_table.log_exposure: log10 exposure relative to an 18% gray card at normal exposure (camera stop 0); the engine clamps outside the end knots
engine_table.aperture: sigma_D at Kodak's 48 um microdensitometer aperture
engine_table.error_reference: relative error of piecewise-linear interpolation of sigma_D at the 0.1-step chart grid points inside the knot range (and the two end points)
engine_table.knot_search: end knots fixed at the range ends; 6 interior positions shared by all layers, chosen by coordinate descent on a 0.01 log_e grid (uniform start + 24 fixed-seed random starts) minimising the max relative error over the three layers with trace values at the knots; minimax_values then re-fits the 8 values per layer (Lawson IRLS) for those positions

notes: Values are darkness-weighted centres of the printed line; the half line width bounds where inside the line the true curve lies.
on_solid: the granularity line is hidden under a characteristic curve and takes that curve's centre (+- one line width).
shared_with_X: two granularity lines print as one; both layers get the same value.
identity_uncertain: two separate lines whose layer assignment cannot be read from the chart (assigned by keeping G above R, as on the labelled right-hand side).
bridged: gap longer than a normal dash gap, filled by linear interpolation; crossing: samples dropped where another line crosses.
edge: the frame line hides the last pixels; value extended linearly from the nearest samples.
